newsitem.title: CHINA: Dazhong fleet expansion boosts H1 net.
newsitem.headline: Dazhong fleet expansion boosts H1 net.

text.p: Shanghai Dazhong Taxi Co Ltd, reporting sharply higher first-half profits, on Friday linked the gains to its expanded fleet of taxis and buses.
Shanghai Dazhong, the city's largest taxi company, had bought out some smaller taxi firms and added more licences, allowing it to put more cars on the road.
"We will continue to acquire smaller taxi firms through purchases or mergers in the second half of the year," a company spokesman told Reuters.
"We have several plans but I can't give you the details," he said.

Shanghai Dazhong reported net profits for the first six months of the year rose 52.7 percent from a year ago to 85.46 million yuan ($10.2 million). Profits were based on domestic accounting standards, which differ from international practice.
Earnings per share were 0.20 yuan, down from 0.34 yuan last year, but that was due to a one-for-one bonus issue that doubled the number of shares outstanding.

The company said it had spent more than 16 million yuan to replace 137 of its older cars with newer model Shanghai-built Volkswagens and had added more than 40 other cars or operating permits. It spent 7 million yuan to buy 70 additional and replacement buses.
Shanghai Dazhong also topped its forecast in its real estate operations with profits of about five million yuan despite an oversupply of property on the local market.
Trading of the company's A and B shares was halted during the morning session to allow the market time to digest the news.
